findings.title: Unsafe rounding of currency conversion result
findings.body: `round(amount_cents * rate)` uses Python’s built-in `round` which rounds half to even, but currency amounts should round half up to avoid systematic bias. Use a currency-aware rounding function or `decimal.Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
findings.suggestion:
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

    rate_dec = Decimal(str(rate))
    amount_dec = Decimal(str(amount_cents))
    return int(amount_dec * rate_dec + Decimal('0.5')) // 1

findings.title: `fetch_rate` result not awaited in async function
findings.body: `converted_cents` is an `async` function but calls `fetch_rate(pair)` without `await`, so the coroutine is returned instead of the rate. Await the call to get the `Decimal` result.

summary.problem: The new async conversion function does not await the rate fetch and uses unsafe rounding, risking incorrect monetary results.
summary.done_well: The module keeps money formatting and currency conversion concerns separate.
